description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder` that provides a base implementation for building answer responses to live commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes mechanisms to set response creation functions and to build command responses, serving as a superclass for specific query command answer builders.
